biomarkers.name: Ki-67
biomarkers.prevalence: >20% (definitional; WHO G3 well-differentiated NET typically 21-55%, though may be higher)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Grade; distinguishes from G2 but does not by itself distinguish G3 NET from NEC

biomarkers.name: Morphology (well-differentiated retained)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Critical distinction from NEC — G3 NET retains organoid morphology; SSTR/DOTATATE avidity is common but not universal, and NEC may occasionally also show uptake

biomarkers.name: SSTR2 expression
biomarkers.prevalence: Often positive; more commonly retained than in NEC, but not universal
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports somatostatin receptor-targeted imaging and potential benefit from SSA/PRRT in appropriate cases

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Well-differentiated NET morphology (organoid growth, salt-and-pepper chromatin) but with high mitotic index / Ki-67
variants: well-differentiated NET G3 (retains organoid morphology) — distinct from NEC

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Well-differentiated GI NET origin but with high proliferation state — same lineage as G1/G2
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains WELL-differentiated neuroendocrine morphology and often SSTR2 expression BUT with Ki-67 >20% and high mitotic rate — this differentiation is critical distinction from NEC
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents high-proliferation state within well-differentiated NET lineage, NOT dedifferentiation to NEC
